# BuilderClan

> A home for people who love to build.

BuilderClan is an open technology community where students, professionals, educators, researchers, founders, and technology enthusiasts learn, collaborate, and build meaningful hardware, software, open-source projects, research, products, and startups.

BuilderClan believes that great products, careers, and communities are built from the foundation up. Members learn by building real-world technology together rather than simply discussing it.

## Highlights

- Open technology community
- Hardware + Software
- Open Source
- Research
- Products
- Startups
- AI, Robotics, IoT, Embedded Systems
- Welcoming to beginners and experienced builders alike

## Programs

### BuilderClan Community

The primary technology community focused on collaborative learning and building.

### BuilderClan on Campus (BCC)

The official campus chapter initiative helping universities create thriving builder communities through projects, workshops, research, open source, hackathons, and leadership.
